Events.Title: Lumen Storm
Events.Callout: The mirror sky is raining light. Lumen motes are falling in the street, and the shades are coming to drink.
Events.Success: You caught the storm in your hands.

Events.Title: A Wound in the Mirror
Events.Callout: A crack is spreading through the Inner World's glass street, and things are climbing out of the deep side.
Events.Objective: Break the crystal heart of the wound
Events.Success: The glass heals over with a sound like a sigh.

Events.Title: Basilisk in the Glass Streets
Events.Callout: A Crystal Basilisk is sunning itself on an Inner World crossroads. Don't stand still in front of it.
Events.Objective: Keep moving, or take its crown
Events.Success: The basilisk's crown gem goes dark. Everything nearby can move again.

Events.Title: Wyvern Dive
Events.Callout: A Violet Wyvern hates the colour of your street lights, and it has brought friends.
Events.Success: The wyvern hits the glass street like a dropped chandelier.

Events.Title: An Echo That Remembers
Events.Callout: An echo of someone is standing in the mirror street, trying to remember their own name.
Events.Name: Echo of a Stranger

Lines.Speaker: Echo of a Stranger
Lines.Text: You can see me? Nobody sees me. I used to sell flowers on this corner. Or I used to be a flower. It's hazy.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: You sold flowers. People don't usually become flowers.

Lines.Speaker: Echo of a Stranger
Lines.Text: That's a relief. Take this. It was in my pocket, and I don't think I have pockets anymore.

Events.Title: Lost in the Veil
Events.Callout: Two pilgrims crossed the Veil to see the mirror city. The Hollows found them first.
Events.Success: The pilgrims stumble back toward the Veil, promising to take up a safer hobby.
Events.Failure: The pilgrims are part of the mirror city now.

Events.Title: Falling Glass Star
Events.Callout: A star made of mirror glass just fell into the Inner World street. Something with your face wants it too.
Events.Success: The glass star is yours. Your reflection in it waves a moment late.
Events.Failure: The glass star dissolved back into the sky.
